# Leadership

Sanjeev Singh Sahni

Sanjeev Singh Sahni was appointed CEO of Xometry in July 2026. He joined the company in January 2025 as President.

An accomplished executive with B2B strategy, e-commerce, AI, and global supply chain management expertise, Sanjeev joined Xometry to lead Product, Technology, Operations, and Talent.

Sanjeev’s career spans decades of identifying, scaling, and leading B2B businesses. Most recently, he worked at Wayfair, where he led their multi-billion-dollar B2B business, transformed B2B and B2C sales and customer experience through its fastest growth years, and built Wayfair’s digital freight forwarding business called CastleGate Forwarding. [...] Connect with Sanjeev on LinkedIn

James Miln

James Miln is the Chief Financial Officer at Xometry, where he oversees financial strategy and operations, including treasury, procurement, investor relations, and finance operations teams.

A veteran of big-name tech and consumer brands, James brings considerable financial planning, operational, and investor relations expertise to Xometry.

Prior to Xometry, James served as Senior Vice President of Finance and Investor Relations at Yelp, steering the company through a period of strong, product-driven growth, including the introduction of new AI-powered search experiences. He also held key leadership roles at eBay, Yahoo!, and Unilever. [...] Prior to Xometry, Oscar served as Senior Director and General Manager at Wayfair, where he led a global workforce of thousands and optimized e-commerce and partner operations. He also held senior positions at McKinsey & Company, where he focused on strategic operations and business transformation, and Procter & Gamble, where he held leadership roles in manufacturing and supply chain management.

Oscar has a master’s of engineering degree in mechanical engineering from The University of Manchester in England.

Connect with Oscar on LinkedIn

Vaidy Raghavan

Vaidy Raghavan is the Chief Technology Officer at Xometry, where he oversees product, engineering, and AI/machine learning across Xometry's global manufacturing marketplace and its Thomas industrial sourcing business.

# Release Details

## Xometry Announces CEO Succession Plan

Sanjeev Singh Sahni to Succeed Randy Altschuler as CEO; Altschuler to Become Executive Chair

NORTH BETHESDA, Md., Feb. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Xometry, Inc. (NASDAQ: XMTR), the global AI-native marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers of custom manufacturing, announced that effective July 1, 2026, Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer, Randy Altschuler, will transition to become the Executive Chair of the Board. Sanjeev Singh Sahni, Xometry’s current President, will succeed Altschuler as Chief Executive Officer and join the Board of Directors. [...] “On behalf of the Board, I want to thank Randy for the extraordinary leadership and vision that has guided Xometry from startup to a leading digital marketplace for custom manufacturing,” said Fabio Rosati, Xometry Chairman of the Board. “Following a disciplined and collaborative succession process, the Board is thrilled to appoint Sanjeev as CEO and Randy as Executive Chairman. Since joining as President, Sanjeev has proven his leadership abilities and demonstrated the strategic and operational vision required to lead Xometry through its next era of expansion.” [...] Upon the formal transition on July 1, Altschuler will move into his role as Executive Chair. In this capacity, he will remain deeply involved in the company’s future, focusing on strategic growth initiatives and key corporate partnerships while incorporating a founder-perspective at the Board level. Rosati will continue as the Lead Independent Director on Xometry’s Board.

Xometry announced on February 24, 2026, that its board approved a leadership transition effective July 1, 2026, elevating President Sanjeev Singh Sahni to chief executive officer and adding him to the board as a Class I director, while expanding the board from six to seven members to accommodate his appointment.
